C1205.title: Criminal Gang Defrauds 76 Victims via WeChat QR Code Scam; “Code Scammer” Sentenced to 11 Months
C1205.summary: In Dongguan’s first case of QR code cash-out theft, a criminal gang organized through WeChat and QQ groups, dividing roles among “code scammers,” “code scanners,” and physical stores to exploit WeChat’s scan-to-pay function.
